description: This file implements a handler for accessing and searching call logs on an Android device. It defines data structures for call log records and search requests, a data source interface, an implementation using Android's content resolver, and a handler class for processing search requests with permission checks and JSON parsing.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a call log record, including number, cached name, date, duration, and type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class representing the parameters for searching call logs, including filters such as limit, offset, name, number, date range, duration, and type.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check read permission and to perform call log search.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing CallLogDataSource, accessing Android's call log content provider.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class handling call log search requests, including permission checks, parsing JSON parameters, executing searches, and formatting results as JSON.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the app has permission to read call logs.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search on the call logs based on the given request parameters.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Handles a call log search request in JSON format, performs permission check, parses request, executes search, and formats response.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a CallLogSearchRequest object.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord into a JSON object for response.
